about: Meridian Osteopathy is a Christchurch clinic in Hillmorton offering osteopathy, acupuncture and herbal medicine. Our hands-on care blends Western osteopathy with traditional Chinese medicine, and our practitioners work closely together so patients get joined-up treatment under one roof.
offer: A supportive, collaborative team of osteopaths, acupuncturists and allied practitioners
Continuous learning and professional development opportunities
Competitive contractor terms, tailored to your experience and discussed at interview
Online patient booking through our Cliniko practice management system
Relocation assistance for those moving to Christchurch, and guidance for overseas applicants on registration, visa applications and settling in

vacancies.title: Massage Therapist
vacancies.requirements: Diploma in Massage Therapy (NZQA Level 5 or above) or equivalent. Massage New Zealand membership preferred. Remedial or sports massage experience an advantage.
vacancies.overview:
We're looking for a skilled massage therapist to join our multidisciplinary clinic in Hillmorton, Christchurch.

You'll work alongside our osteopaths and acupuncturists, providing remedial, sports and relaxation massage that complements each client's wider treatment plan.
responsibilities: Assess clients and deliver remedial, sports and relaxation massage tailored to their needs
Work with our osteopaths and acupuncturists to support shared clients' treatment plans
Give practical aftercare advice, such as stretches and self-care between sessions
Keep clear, accurate clinical notes in Cliniko
Help create a friendly, professional experience for every client
essential: Diploma in Massage Therapy (NZQA Level 5 or above) or an equivalent qualification
The right to work in New Zealand, or eligibility for a suitable visa
Excellent communication skills and a client-centred approach
desirable: Experience in remedial or sports massage
Experience working in a multidisciplinary clinic
vacancies.hours: Flexible days and hours, to be agreed. The clinic is open Monday to Friday 9am–7pm and Saturday 9am–5pm.

vacancies.title: Acupuncturist
vacancies.requirements: Current registration with the Chinese Medicine Council of New Zealand (CMCNZ), or eligible to obtain it before starting. ACC provider registration an advantage.
vacancies.overview:
We're looking for an acupuncturist to join our team in Hillmorton, Christchurch.

You'll treat a wide range of patients, from pain and injury to stress, sleep, women's health and fertility support, alongside our osteopaths in a clinic that blends Western osteopathy with traditional Chinese medicine.
responsibilities: Assess patients and deliver safe, effective acupuncture treatment
Treat a broad caseload, including pain and injury, stress and sleep, digestive health, women's health and fertility support
Work alongside our osteopaths on shared patient care and cross-referrals
Complete ACC documentation for eligible injury patients, if you're an ACC provider
Keep accurate clinical records in Cliniko and meet CMCNZ professional standards
essential: Current registration with the Chinese Medicine Council of New Zealand (CMCNZ), or eligibility to obtain it before you start
A recognised qualification in acupuncture or Chinese medicine
The right to work in New Zealand, or eligibility for a suitable visa
Strong communication skills and a patient-centred approach
desirable: Experience in fertility, women's health or musculoskeletal acupuncture
Experience working in a multidisciplinary clinic
vacancies.hours: Flexible days and hours, to be agreed. The clinic is open Monday to Friday 9am–7pm and Saturday 9am–5pm.

vacancies.title: Medical Herbalist
vacancies.requirements: Degree in Medical Herbalism or Naturopathy (e.g. BHSc / BNatMed) or equivalent. Membership of the NZ Association of Medical Herbalists (NZAMH), or eligibility, preferred.
vacancies.overview:
We're looking for a medical herbalist to help grow our herbal medicine service in Hillmorton, Christchurch.

You'll prepare personalised herbal prescriptions for patients with pain and inflammation, stress and sleep concerns, digestive health and hormonal balance, working closely with our osteopaths and acupuncturists.
responsibilities: Carry out thorough consultations and prepare individualised herbal prescriptions
Support patients with pain and inflammation, stress and sleep, digestive health and hormonal balance
Screen for herb–drug interactions and contraindications, and refer patients on when appropriate
Work alongside our osteopaths and acupuncturists on integrated treatment plans
Keep accurate clinical and dispensing records in Cliniko
essential: A degree in medical herbalism or naturopathy (e.g. BHSc or BNatMed) or an equivalent qualification
Sound knowledge of herb–drug interactions and safe prescribing
The right to work in New Zealand, or eligibility for a suitable visa
Strong communication skills and a patient-centred approach
desirable: Membership of the NZ Association of Medical Herbalists (NZAMH), or eligibility
Training or experience in Chinese herbal medicine
vacancies.hours: Flexible days and hours, to be agreed. The clinic is open Monday to Friday 9am–7pm and Saturday 9am–5pm.
